sourceChecks.text: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: レビ族コハテの子孫を家系ごとに記す中で、アムラムはコハテの子らの一人として挙げられます。

sourceChecks.text: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: レビ族コハテの子孫を家系ごとに記す中で、アムラムはコハテの子らの一人として挙げられます。

sourceChecks.text: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: レビ族コハテの子孫を家系ごとに記す中で、アムラムはコハテの子らの一人として挙げられます。

wikipediaArticleRead.identityBasisJa: The article identifies the biblical Amram as husband of Jochebed and father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam; the Numbers genealogy cites this same person.
